metadata.description: Marketplace for the skill-or-not plugin: decide what shape a workflow deserves, and audit the skills you already have.

plugins.name: skill-or-not
plugins.description: Decides whether a problem, workflow, or intent should become a skill, a script, a CLI, a hook, a subagent, an MCP server, a scheduled job, a plugin, or nothing at all — and audits existing skills for whether their shape is still right.
